# GENERAL PLAN (May 26 2026)

1. Load in MAR tonnage from CONAPESCA
2. Prepare CONAPESCA tonnage as needed

3. Filter data down to the GOC region

4. Load in MAR seafood watch scores
5. Prepare seafood watch scores as needed

6. Multiply MAR seafood watch scores by tonnage per region to get a "weighted tonnage".

## clean_names_lowercase function
```{r Load clean_names_lowercase function}
# Takes text and standardizes it, which we will need for merging later on:

clean_names_lowercase <- function(x) {

  x <- iconv(x, from = "", to = "UTF-8", sub = "")
  x <- stringi::stri_trans_general(x, "Latin-ASCII")

  x %>%
    tolower() %>%
    trimws()
}
```

```{r Look into oysters}
TEST<- GOC_MarineLandings0 %>%
  filter(estimated_taxa_group == "OSTION")

table(TEST$sector_estimate_draft)
```

```{r Assume MOST oyster production is wild catch}
# What if we assume these oysters are wild unless flagged as aquaculture?
# “ostión roca” (rock oyster)
# Likely wild, reef-attached species such as Crassostrea corteziensis or possibly Saccostrea palmula.
# “ostión placer”
# “Placer” usually refers to natural beds (sediment or sandbar areas), so again most likely Crassostrea corteziensis.
# “ostión mangle” (mangrove oyster)
# Typically associated with mangrove roots—best match is Saccostrea palmula.

# Within the OSTION group, I want to assign sector_estimate_draft == "marine: aquaculture" in all cases where 
# common_name_clean %in% c(ostion, ostion americano, ostion europeo, ostion japones, ostion kumamoto).
# But, when common_name_clean %in% c(ostion mangle, ostion placer, ostion roca), do not reassign the sector_estimate_draft

GOC_MarineLandings <- GOC_MarineLandings0 %>%
  mutate(sector_estimate_draft = if_else(
    estimated_taxa_group == "OSTION" &
    common_name_clean %in% c(
      "ostion", "ostion americano", "ostion europeo",
      "ostion japones", "ostion kumamoto"
    ),
    "marine: aquaculture",
    sector_estimate_draft
  ))

```


```{r Plot Oysters}
Oyster_summary<- GOC_MarineLandings %>%
  filter(estimated_family_name=="Ostreidae") %>%
  dplyr::select(year, weight_kg_corrected, value) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    annual_production_mt = sum(weight_kg_corrected, na.rm = TRUE) / 1000,
    annual_value_pesos   = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
# 27 obs., 3 vars.
  

# Plot:
Oyster_summary %>%
  filter(year >= START_EVALUATION_PERIOD, year<= END_EVALUATION_PERIOD) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = annual_production_mt)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Production (mt)",
    color = "Source"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

```

# STEP 4: Identify most common mariculture taxa in NW Mexico ------------------------------

```{r Generate a table of most common mariculture species since START_EVALUATION_PERIOD}
MAR_n.records_byGenus <- GOC_Mariculture %>%
  filter(year >= START_EVALUATION_PERIOD, year<= END_EVALUATION_PERIOD) %>%
  filter(!is.na(estimated_genus_name) & estimated_genus_name != "NEI" & estimated_genus_name != "unknown") %>%
  dplyr::select(estimated_genus_name, Major_Functional_Group) %>%
  group_by(Major_Functional_Group, estimated_genus_name) %>%
  summarise(
    n_records = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Filter out the most common genera:
MAR_n.records_byGenus<- MAR_n.records_byGenus %>%
  filter(n_records > 15)
# 12 obs.

MAR_GENERA_OF_INTEREST<- unique(MAR_n.records_byGenus$estimated_genus_name)
# Micropogonias (croaker) and Morone (bass) is a new add - Oct 2026
# Fortunately this is covered with the same MBay Seafoowatch Score as totoaba and other fish.
# Moreover, the genus Morone is a primarily freshwater genus.

```


# STEP 7: Summarize CONAPESCA data in all years all states at the family level  ------------------------------

NOTE: I am estimating mariculture at the family level is because shrimp is reported unreliably at the genus level. Sometimes reported as Paneaus, Litopeanus and it messes up the weighting scheme.

```{r Summarize CONAPESCA mariculture data in all years all states in the GOC}

table(GOC_Mariculture$OHI_rgn_id)

# Summarized Production for CONAPESCA cosecha production in all years.
GOC_Mariculture_byRegion <- GOC_Mariculture %>%
  filter(year >= START_EVALUATION_PERIOD, year <= END_EVALUATION_PERIOD) %>%
  group_by(estimated_family_name, year, OHI_rgn_id) %>%
  summarise(total_est_production_mt = (sum(weight_kg_corrected, na.rm = TRUE)/1000),
            .groups = "drop")
```

```{r Load in MAR weights}
MAR_Weights0<- read.csv("/home/ferrer/ohi_goc_prep/FP/v2026/FP_Scores_1.1/MAR_Scores_1.1/copy_MAR_WeightingScores_FINAL_May062026.csv",
                        skip = 1,
                        header= TRUE)

colnames(MAR_Weights0)

MAR_GenusWeights<- MAR_Weights0 %>%
  filter(Abridged == "keep")

MAR_GenusWeights <- MAR_GenusWeights %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Major_Functional_Group,
    estimated_family_name = Family,
    estimated_genus_name = Genus,
    Est_Sustainability_Score
  ) %>%
  distinct()

```

```{r Estimate weights by major functional groups}
MAR_GroupWeights<- MAR_GenusWeights %>%
  dplyr::select(Major_Functional_Group,
         Est_Sustainability_Score) %>%
  group_by(Major_Functional_Group) %>%
  summarise(mean_Sustainability_Score = mean(Est_Sustainability_Score, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  distinct()

```

```{r Estimate harvest groups and merge to MAR_GroupWeights}
options(pillar.sigfig = 3)

colnames(GOC_Mariculture)

# Summarize harvest amounts per Major_Functional_Group from 2018-2025 among MAR_FAMILIES_OF_INTEREST:  
MAR_bySector0 <- GOC_Mariculture %>%
  filter(estimated_family_name %in% MAR_FAMILIES_OF_INTEREST) %>%
  filter(year >= START_EVALUATION_PERIOD, year <= END_EVALUATION_PERIOD) %>%
  group_by(Major_Functional_Group, year, OHI_rgn_id) %>%
  summarise(total_est_production_mt = (sum(weight_kg_corrected, na.rm = TRUE)/1000),
            .groups = "drop")
# 146 obs., 4 vars.

# Merge the harvest amounts with the sustainability scores:
MAR_bySector0 <- MAR_bySector0 %>%
  left_join(
    MAR_GroupWeights,
    by = c("Major_Functional_Group")
  )
```

# **DECISION POINT**: Reference point and period

```{r REFERENCE POINT}
# Production will be 20% higher than production between 2020-2024 (our reference period)
# source: p. 25, https://www.gob.mx/cms/uploads/attachment/file/616554/PROGRAMA_Nacional_de_Pesca_y_Acuacultura_2020-2024baja.pdf
REF_POINT = 1.2

START_REF_PERIOD = 2020
END_REF_PERIOD = 2024

```

```{r Calculate production per sector}
table(MAR_bySector0$Major_Functional_Group)

# Assign mariculture sector:
MAR_bySector <- MAR_bySector0 %>%
  mutate(
    Mariculture_Sector = case_when(
      Major_Functional_Group == "Demersal marine fishes" ~ "finfish",
      Major_Functional_Group == "Pelagic marine fish (excl. anchovy & sardine)" ~ "finfish",
      Major_Functional_Group == "Molluscs excl. Cephalopods" ~ "bivalves",
      Major_Functional_Group == "Shrimps, prawns" ~ "shrimp",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
# 146 obs., 6 vars.


# Calculate mean production for that Mariculture_Sector from START_EVALUATION_PERIOD to END_EVALUATION_PERIOD:

colnames(MAR_bySector)

# First, calculate annual sector production and sustainability:
MAR_bySector <- MAR_bySector %>%
  group_by(year, OHI_rgn_id, Mariculture_Sector) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_Sustainability_Score = mean(
      mean_Sustainability_Score,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    total_est_production_mt = sum(
      total_est_production_mt,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Then calculate production during the reference period (2020-2024) and pre-2020:
MAR_reference <- MAR_bySector %>%
  group_by(OHI_rgn_id, Mariculture_Sector) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_prod_mt_ref.period = {
      x <- total_est_production_mt[
        year >= START_EVALUATION_PERIOD &
        year <= END_EVALUATION_PERIOD
      ]
      if (length(x) == 0 || all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    },

    mean_prod_mt_ref.period = {
      x <- total_est_production_mt[year >= START_REF_PERIOD & year <= END_REF_PERIOD]
      if (length(x) == 0 || all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    },

    mean_prod_mt_pre.2020 = {
      x <- total_est_production_mt[year >= START_EVALUATION_PERIOD & year < START_REF_PERIOD]
      if (length(x) == 0 || all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    },

    .groups = "drop"
  )


# Then join:
MAR_bySector <- MAR_bySector %>%
  left_join(
    MAR_reference,
    by = c("Mariculture_Sector", "OHI_rgn_id")
  )

# 136 obs., 7 vars.

# Limit number of decimal places, easier viewing:
MAR_bySector<- MAR_bySector %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric) & !all_of("year"), ~ round(.x, 2)))

```

# STEP 10: Calculate MAR scores! ------------------------------

```{r Shrimp Scores}

colnames(MAR_bySector)
table(MAR_bySector$Mariculture_Sector)

# SHRIMP scores dataframe:
SHRMP_Scores <- MAR_bySector %>%
  filter(Mariculture_Sector == "shrimp") %>%
  mutate(
    # Production relative to reference point
    today_v_reference = total_est_production_mt /
      (REF_POINT * mean_prod_mt_ref.period),
    
    # Must cap ratio at one so as not to artificially inflate scores:
    today_v_reference_capped = pmin(today_v_reference, 1),

    # Sector score (keep in mind that the MBay Sust. Coeff is scaled 0-10):
    SHRMP_score = today_v_reference_capped *
      (mean_Sustainability_Score / 10) * 100,
 
    SHRMP_score = round(pmin(SHRMP_score, 100), 2)
    
    ) %>%
  select(
    year, OHI_rgn_id, Mariculture_Sector,
    total_est_production_mt,
    mean_prod_mt_ref.period,
    today_v_reference,
    today_v_reference_capped,
    mean_Sustainability_Score,
    SHRMP_score
  )
# 50 obs., 9 vars.

```

```{r Plot the SHRMP_scores}
SHRMP_Scores %>%
```

# Final MAR_Scores

```{r Merge scores into MAR_scores0}
shrimp_df <- SHRMP_Scores %>%
  select(
    OHI_rgn_id,
    year,
    SHRMP_score,
    shrimp_production_mt = total_est_production_mt
  )

finfish_df <- FNFSH_Scores %>%
  select(
    OHI_rgn_id,
    year,
    FNFSH_score,
    finfish_production_mt = total_est_production_mt
  )

bivalves_df <- BIVLV_Scores %>%
  select(
    OHI_rgn_id,
    year,
    BIVLV_score,
    bivalve_production_mt = total_est_production_mt
  )

MAR_scores00 <- full_join(
  shrimp_df,
  finfish_df,
  by = c("OHI_rgn_id", "year")
)

MAR_scores00 <- full_join(
  MAR_scores00,
  bivalves_df,
  by = c("OHI_rgn_id", "year")
)

```

```{r Caculate MAR_scores by weighting each sector}

colnames(MAR_scores00)

# Create total production column: 
MAR_scores0<- MAR_scores00 %>%
  mutate(
      total_production_mt = rowSums(
      across(c(shrimp_production_mt, finfish_production_mt, bivalve_production_mt)),
      na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Calculate sector contribution to total catch:
MAR_scores0<- MAR_scores0 %>%
  mutate(
    shrimp_catch_contribution = round(shrimp_production_mt / total_production_mt, 2),
    finfish_catch_contribution = round(finfish_production_mt / total_production_mt, 2),
    bivalve_catch_contribution = round(bivalve_production_mt / total_production_mt, 2)
  )


# Calculate final mar score based on sector score and contribution:
MAR_scores0<- MAR_scores0 %>%
  mutate(
    SHRMP_score_contribution = round(SHRMP_score * shrimp_catch_contribution, 2),
    FNFSH_score_contribution = round(FNFSH_score * finfish_catch_contribution, 2),
    BIVLV_score_contribution = round(BIVLV_score * bivalve_catch_contribution, 2),
    
    MAR_score = rowSums(across(c(SHRMP_score_contribution, FNFSH_score_contribution, BIVLV_score_contribution)), na.rm = TRUE),
    
    MAR_score= round(MAR_score, 2)
  ) %>%
  select(
    OHI_rgn_id, year, 
    SHRMP_score, shrimp_production_mt, shrimp_catch_contribution,
    BIVLV_score, bivalve_production_mt, bivalve_catch_contribution,
    FNFSH_score, finfish_production_mt, finfish_catch_contribution,
    SHRMP_score_contribution, FNFSH_score_contribution, BIVLV_score_contribution,
    MAR_score, MAR_production_mt= total_production_mt
  )
# 67 obs., 12 vars.

colnames(MAR_scores0)

```

```{r Complete the FOFM_SubScores grid}
MAR_scores <- MAR_scores0 %>%
    select(
    rgn_id= OHI_rgn_id, year, 
    MAR_score, MAR_production_mt
  ) %>%
  
  filter(!is.na(rgn_id)) %>%
  
  complete(
    rgn_id = paste0("Region_", 1:9),
    year = full_seq(year, 1),
    fill = list(
      MAR_score = NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(rgn_id, year)

# 72 obs., 4 vars.
```

```{r Different shape dataframe}
head(MAR_scores)

MAR_scores_long<- MAR_scores %>%
  dplyr::select(rgn_name, year, 
         SHRMP_score, FNFSH_score, BIVLV_score,
         MAR_score) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(SHRMP_score, FNFSH_score, BIVLV_score,
         MAR_score),
    names_to = "type",
    values_to = "score"
  )

colnames(MAR_scores_long)
```

```{r Plot MAR_scores_long}
# Component plot:
REGION_COLORS<- c(
  "Western Upper Gulf" = "#C03729",
  "Western Midriff Islands" = "#E68C7C",
  "Western Central Gulf" = "#FC8F24",
  "Western Southern Gulf" = "#dcaa38",
  "Eastern Upper Gulf" = "#cbd2a0",
  "Eastern Midriff Islands" = "#98a25a",
  "Southern Sonora Coast" = "#747428",
  "Sinaloa Coast" = "#627391",
  "Southeastern Gulf" = "#8d61a9")

Component_colors <- c(
  "#F28E2B",  # bright orange
  "#009E73",  # green
  "#D94F3D"   # warm red coral
)

MAR_Scores_component_plot <-

  ggplot() +

  ## Component scores (shrimp, bivalves, finfish):
  geom_line(
    data = MAR_scores_long %>% 
      filter(type != "MAR_score",
             !is.na(rgn_name)),
    aes(
      x = year,
      y = score,
      color = type,
      group = interaction(type, rgn_name)
    ),
    linewidth = 0.75,
    alpha= 0.4
  ) +

  # geom_point(
  #   data = MAR_scores_long %>% 
  #     filter(type != "MAR_score",
  #            !is.na(rgn_name)),
  #   aes(
  #     x = year,
  #     y = score,
  #     color = type
  #   ),
  #   size = 1,
  #   alpha= 0.3
  # ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Component score",
    values = Component_colors
  ) +

  ## Start a new color scale
  new_scale_color() +

  ## Total scores (region colors)
  geom_line(
    data = MAR_scores_long %>% 
      filter(type == "MAR_score",
             !is.na(rgn_name)),
    aes(
      x = year,
      y = score,
      color = rgn_name,
      group = rgn_name
    ),
    linewidth = 1.25
  ) +

  geom_point(
    data = MAR_scores_long %>% 
      filter(type == "MAR_score",
             !is.na(rgn_name)),
    aes(
      x = year,
      y = score,
      color = rgn_name
    ),
    size = 2
  ) +

  facet_wrap(~rgn_name) +
  
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Region",
    values = REGION_COLORS
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "MAR Scores by Region",
    subtitle= "updated: Jul 15 2026",
    y = "MAR Score (from 0 to 100)",
    x = "Year"
  ) +
  
  geom_hline(yintercept = 100, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +

  ylim(0, 101) +
  
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
  )

MAR_Scores_component_plot
```
